viewing_check: Check the underside and base for casting marks, seams, hollow core, weight (heavy solid thick casting and worn, dirty crevice patina suggests older; light, crisp, even patina suggests modern), any inscription or stamp, how the figure is fixed to the plinth, and any cracks, repairs or losses to fingers. Measure the height.
